title.zh: South Korea Arrests Seven in First Big AI-Assisted Hacking Case
title.en: South Korea Arrests Seven in First Big AI-Assisted Hacking Case

current_state.zh: Seoul police arrested seven people, including a 32-year-old alleged ringleader who used generative AI coding and autonomous pentesting tools to breach about 90 South Korean organizations and steal 8.2 million records in what police call the country's first major AI-assisted hacking bust.
